description: Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 30B A3B Q5_K_L by bartowski
gpu_tip: ~29GB total — Nemotron 3.5's hybrid Mamba/MoE layers keep that number close to the file size regardless of context length. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 5060) plus ~24GB of DDR5 system RAM is enough, with llama.cpp offloading the routed experts.
mac_tip: Needs ~29GB — fits a 32GB MacBook Pro comfortably.
